subject: general
question: Which of the following nation is NOT a member of the BIMSTEC organisation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maldives**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Maldives is not a member of the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC)
 
• The seven member countries of BIMSTEC are Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, and Thailand.
 
• BIMSTEC is a regional organization that includes countries from the Bay of Bengal region, which is a bridge between South Asia and Southeast Asia. 
 
• BIMSTEC is different from the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC), which focuses on South Asia.
 
• Pakistan and Afghanistan are members of SAARC but not BIMSTEC.
